assessment: The distinct onset and debris sequence read as a compact small ground burst. At actual shot context it is too small and subdued to replace the current principal battlefield eruption. It does not solve the larger explosion's force, expanding mass, ground damage or cinematic finish.
decision: Preserve as an unaccepted compact-impact study; do not substitute into this refinement merely because import checks passed.
current_v003_limit: The retained tall painted plume remains too self-contained and cloud-like. It needs stronger changing silhouettes, near/middle/far separation, directional expansion, terrain interaction and a persistent disturbance, judged in the shot.
next_FX_work: Design larger impulse and expansion keys against the actual camera and children before adding texture.
Make debris rise, fall and meet the terrain with readable landing cues and a persistent scar.
Retain light response from the actual source and avoid covering the children or making an all-white bloom patch.
